died.name: Victims of the Lake Nyos disaster
died.cause: At Lake Nyos, northwestern Cameroon, a limnic eruption of unknown cause released about 100,000–300,000 tons of carbon dioxide (CO2) from the lake's bed. The gas cloud initially rose at nearly 100 km/h and then, being heavier than air, descended onto nearby villages, suffocating people and livestock within 25 km of the lake, resulting in the death of 1,746 people and 3,500 livestock.
